plan.title: Create auction from open asset PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and avoid the publish restriction described in the case.
Assert that the auction stage has a template applied before configuring its sheet.
Verify key PR-populated product and quantity fields are read-only on the sheet.
Provide the mandatory event title required before publishing.
Add the two vendors explicitly named in the case.
Publish the completed PR-derived auction event.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published event's Settings menu to inspect the PR-specific recreation action.
Verify that Recreate Order is greyed out on the published PR-derived event.
